title: NoduleFinding
description: One nodule mention extracted from a radiology report. Fields marked readOnly are computed by deterministic code after extraction; the model never fills them and they are stripped from the tool schema sent to the model. Every field is a statement from the report, never an inference.

id.description: Short id you assign: n1, n2, ...

count_context.description: Does the report describe one nodule or several in the lungs? 'unclear' when it does not say.

size_text.description: The size exactly as written, for example '9 x 7 mm'. null when no size is stated.

dimensions_mm.description: Numbers stated for this nodule, in millimetres (convert cm to mm), in the order written. [] when no size is stated. Never estimate.

size_basis.description: stated_single: one dimension. two_axes: two or more dimensions. unspecified: no size.

attenuation.description: As stated. 'unknown' when the report does not say.

solid_component_mm.description: Size of the solid component of a part-solid nodule when stated, else null.

lobe.description: Lobe as written, else null. A phrase like 'mid-lung zone' is not a lobe: use null.

stability_text.description: Verbatim stability statement, for example 'stable since 2023', else null.

assertion.description: present: the report states the nodule is there. negated: the report says there is none ('No pulmonary nodules'). hedged: uncertain wording ('possible', 'cannot exclude', 'versus vessel').

sentence_id.description: Id of the sentence, for example s014.

quote.description: A verbatim excerpt of that sentence that supports the finding.

evidence.description: At least one item. Quote copied character for character.

mean_diameter_mm.description: Computed: mean of two axes rounded to the nearest mm, or the single stated size.

confidence.description: Computed by regex cross-check against the evidence sentence. Never self-rated by the model.
